statement.zh: 教科文将哈尔施塔特–达赫施泰因/萨尔茨卡默古特文化景观列入世界遗产，强调史前盐业与聚落（UNESCO 806）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Hallstatt-Dachstein / Salzkammergut Cultural Landscape as World Heritage, emphasizing prehistoric salt industry and settlement (UNESCO 806).
